newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet due on agenda of Italy cabinet on Fri.
newsitem.headline: Stet due on agenda of Italy cabinet on Fri.

text.p: Italy's cabinet will meet on Friday at 0830 GMT and is likely to discuss telecoms holding Stet after the government's narrow defeat in parliament on a decree to transfer it to the Treasury, government sources said.
The government lost on the decree concerning the transfer of Stet from state industrial holding IRI on Wednesday night with a vote of 230 for, 234 against, and 26 abstentions.
The transfer to the Treasury is a preliminary step in the merger of Stet with its operating subsidiary Telecom Italia and the privatisation this year of the merged entity.
The Treasury said the vote would not sink the transfer plan because it was attached to part of the 1997 budget and effectively had "already taken place."
It added that the government would provide "appropriate solutions" to complete those aspects of the plan that were regulated by the decree which was botched by parliament.
